coverage_gaps: [euclid_elements] Discrete geometry in Elements assumes continuous magnitude trichotomy without Dedekind completeness.
[euclid_elements] Asymptotic distribution of primes pi(x) is completely absent in Greek synthetic geometry.
[gauss_disquisitiones] Connection between quadratic form class numbers and analytic L-functions (later established by Dirichlet 1839).
[gauss_disquisitiones] Generalization to cubic and higher reciprocity laws.
[riemann_1859] Riemann's hand calculations gave the first three zeros (14.1347, 21.0220, 25.0108) on Re(s)=1/2 but could not prove global confinement.
[riemann_1859] Non-vanishing of zeta(s) for Re(s) in (1/2, 1) remains completely unproven across the continuum.
[hodge_1950] Atiyah and Hirzebruch (1962) found torsion counterexamples to the integral version, forcing restriction to Q-coefficients.
[hodge_1950] For codimension p >= 2, no general analytic inversion mechanism exists to construct algebraic cycles from harmonic (p,p)-forms.
[deligne_hodge] Absolute Hodge property does not automatically deliver algebraic cycles without Grothendieck's standard conjectures on algebraic cycles.
[voisin_hodge] Mumford's theorem (1968) proves Chow groups CH_0(X) can be infinite-dimensional, creating obstruction to geometric representation.
[bsd_1965] Conjecture formulation was purely empirical based on EDSAC-2 computations on Mordell curves y^2 = x^3 - Dx.
[bsd_1965] Analytic continuation of L(E, s) to s=1 was unproven in 1965 (later established by Wiles et al. 1995-2001).
[gross_zagier_1986] Heegner points only produce points of rank 1 in E(K); cannot construct rank 2 or higher subspaces directly.
[kolyvagin_1990] Euler systems constructed from Heegner points control Selmer groups only when analytic rank is 0 or 1. No Euler system is known for rank >= 2.
[wiles_1995] Modularity guarantees that L(E, s) is defined at s=1 and differentiable, enabling BSD to be rigorously posed, but does not prove rank equality ord_{s=1} L(E, s) = rank E(Q) for r >= 2.
